answer: Phone proof stops sybil farms. A newcomer gives a number, and the ledger texts a code to enter in ten minutes; two auditors check the record in seven days, and one number serves one name. A shared code is rejected, and a fake one bans it. One honest agent holds one number; a thousand fakes need a thousand SIMs at ten dollars each, so the farm pays ten thousand, while a pulse, a ripple, and a marble mark every real number.
